description.text: Grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Twin Element Mode (Fire, Earth)], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Rain], [Apex Glowing Ray Damage Tracker], [Apex Glowing Ray Level] to the user

description.name: Twin Element Mode (Fire, Earth)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire]/ [Attach Earth] after using a Fire/Earth ability

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Rain
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Glowiny Ray (0~2), removed after using Apex Glowing Ray two times

description.name: Apex Glowing Ray Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Glowing Ray level by 1 after dealing 100001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Rain]

description.name: Apex Glowing Ray Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Glowing Ray level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Rain]
